title: Mother and Daughters on Ship Deck, 1956 Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A black-and-white snapshot showing a mother and two young girls standing on the open deck of a ship or ferry. They are dressed in typical mid-1950s casual travel attire, including a gingham dress, cardigans, and vertically striped capri pants. In the background, two boys stand by the deck railing looking out over the water alongside empty rows of wooden slatted benches. The back is stamped with a processing date of February 9, 1956.
